brand.title: strad Brand & Philosophy
brand.description: What strad is (a self-hosted MCP gateway: one endpoint, many MCP servers, selected per request), who it's for, and the opinions that follow: selection is not authorization, it fails closed with 424, auth is the only gate because there is no perimeter, a platform rather than a bundle of integrations, and honest about which guarantees are policy rather than physics. Read before writing anything user-facing.

brand-voice.title: strad Brand Voice
brand-voice.description: How strad sounds in writing (docs, README, console copy, PRs): plain, direct, honest, specific — lowercase 'strad', counts that agree across pages, and no AI-slop tells. Downstream of the brand reference; apply it to all prose.

anti-slop-rubric.title: Anti-slop Rubric
anti-slop-rubric.description: A gradeable per-page checklist for keeping the docs from reading or looking AI-generated: voice tells (contrast framing, rule of three, hype words, emphasis-bold, count drift) and design tells (colored stripes, tinted-pill nav, line noise, colored glows). Use it to grade and fix prose and theme.
